title: Deductible Burden Allowance: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) Training Note
content:
**Rule.** On an insured Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account, the account's deductible liability postings are totalled. A total of at least 1000.00 USD adds one percentage point to the non-covered discount percent for each full 250.00 of that total, never more than 6 points; a total of at least 500.00 but below 1000.00 adds a flat 1.5 percentage points; a smaller total adds none.

## Questions answered

**What is totalled?** Every deductible liability posting on the account, whatever claim it came from. Coinsurance, copay and non-covered-service postings are not part of the total.

**How are the points counted in the top range?** By full 250.00 steps of the total: the total divided by 250.00, dropping any fraction, gives the points, and the result is held at 6.

**What does a total between 500.00 and 999.99 add?** Always 1.5 points, whatever its exact size.

## Worked figures (hypothetical totals)

| Deductible total | Range | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| 2400.00 | at least 1000.00 | 9 full steps, held at 6 |
| 1500.00 | at least 1000.00 | 6 |
| 1249.99 | at least 1000.00 | 4 |
| 1000.00 | at least 1000.00 | 4 |
| 999.99 | 500.00 to below 1000.00 | 1.5 |
| 500.00 | 500.00 to below 1000.00 | 1.5 |
| 499.99 | below 500.00 | none |
